plots.name: clock-demo
plots.title: A ticker you can stop
plots.lesson: Predict: what changes if the interval doubles? Try this ticker, watch its pulses, then change 1s to 2s and try again. Open Patchbay and select the ticker to follow the cord from time/every to presentation/tick. Lull stops the run; Wake admits another run. This specimen shows a repeating pulse, not the time of day.

plots.name: memory_lantern
plots.title: Turn keystrokes into text
plots.lesson: Try the plot, focus the running example, and type a short message. Open Patchbay and select Memory Lantern: follow keyboard events through key mapping and bounded editing to visible text. Which part turns an event into a character? Your body survives reload; this example does not promise to retain the message.
